title: Single cell isolation from human fetal thigh
author: Hongbo Zhang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ta8eihw
materials: Single cell isolation from human fetal thigh
! Prepare all the buffers before the experiment!
While holding the dish under the angle:

steps.title: Prepare Liberase TH Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2.5 mg/ml Liberase TH stock solution.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 1 vial of 5mg Liberase TH powder in 2ml of 1X PBS.
Store as 400ul aliquots at -20°C.
Thaw on ice before use.
Dilute 100ul of Liberase TH stock solution in 4.9ml of 1X PBS.

steps.title: Prepare 1X RBC Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 1X RBC Lysis Buffer using one of two methods.

substeps.instruction: Method 1: Dilute 10X RBC Lysis Buffer (eBioscience 00-4300) 1:10 with room temperature, reagent-grade water.
Method 2: Use 1X RBC Lysis Buffer (eBioscience 00-4333) directly.

steps.title: Prepare FBS Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2% FBS in 1X PBS solution.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 200ul FBS in 9.8ml 1X PBS.

steps.title: Dissect and Process Tissue
steps.instruction: Dissect the fetal thigh and prepare the tissue for digestion.

substeps.instruction: Dissect the left and right thigh into two pieces of whole upper half of the fetal thigh.
Keep one piece in 10% neutral-buffered formalin for histology or RNAscope (record tissue ID).
Place the other piece in a 60mm dish, positioned closer to the wall and avoiding the center.
Mechanically chop the muscle into a mash using a scalpel.

steps.title: Digest Tissue with Liberase
steps.instruction: Digest the tissue mash using the Liberase working solution.

substeps.instruction: Add 2ml of Liberase working solution to the tissue mash and transfer to a 15ml falcon tube.
Apply another 2ml of Liberase working solution to the area and transfer to the same 15ml falcon tube.
Apply the final 1ml of Liberase working solution to the same location and transfer to the same 15ml tube (total volume should be 5ml).
Incubate the 15ml tube in a 37°C water bath for 30 minutes.
After 15 minutes of digestion, gently mix the solution with a 1ml tip to facilitate digestion.
Visually check digestion; if not fully digested, incubate for another 5 minutes at 37°C (do not exceed 40 minutes total incubation).

steps.title: Initial Cell Recovery
steps.instruction: Collect the cells from the digestion process.

substeps.instruction: Spin down the 15ml falcon tube at 4°C at 750g for 5 minutes.
Visually check for cells and tissue debris at the bottom.
Carefully decant the supernatant.

steps.title: Perform Red Blood Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: Remove red blood cells (skip steps 8-12 if fetus is younger than 8 weeks).

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 3ml of 1X RBC buffer and incubate for 4–5 minutes at room temperature (RT).
Stop the lysis reaction by adding 10ml of 1X PBS and gently mixing.
Spin down the 15ml falcon tube at 4°C at 750g for 5 minutes.
Visually check for cells and tissue debris at the bottom and carefully decant the supernatant.

steps.title: Filter and Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Filter the cells and perform a final wash.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the cells in 5ml of 2% FBS in 1x PBS.
Filter the suspension through a 40um strainer.
Spin down the 15ml falcon tube at 4°C at 750g for 5 minutes.
Visually check for cells at the bottom and carefully decant the supernatant.

steps.title: Final Resuspension and Quantification
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final cell pellet and quantify the cells.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the cells in 50-200ul of 2% FBS in PBS (volume depends on the size of the cell pellet).
Mix 10ul of the cells with 10ul of trypan blue and quantify using a hemocytometer.

description: Troubleshooting: If the pellet is not visible add 300ul of FBS to get the final 2% solution. Mix well and spin down again at 4C at 750g for 5min.
